subject.statement: Changpeng Zhao is still serving his prison sentence.

summary: Changpeng Zhao pleaded guilty in November 2023 to AML violations and was sentenced to four months in prison. He began serving the sentence in early 2024 and was released by mid‑2024, so by October 2026 he is no longer incarcerated.
